title: Arte
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In early 16th-century Florence, Arte, daughter of a declining noble house, has a gift for painting. After her father dies her mother pushes her to marry, but Arte leaves her rank behind, is turned away by workshop after workshop, cuts her hair and is finally taken on as apprentice by the painter Leo, a former beggar. Later she works in Venice as a family painter and tutor while she grows toward becoming a master.
life_message: A woman's calling to her craft is worth hard work and sacrifice, even against the expectations of family and society.
